name: Arrow Electronics, Inc.
sector: Technology distribution / Electronic components & enterprise computing
moat_justification: Scale duopoly with Avnet in global components distribution plus design-in and supply-chain services give real but narrow advantages; the business is a thin-margin, working-capital-heavy intermediary with no pricing power — gross margin fell from 13.0% (FY2022) to 11.2% (FY2025) and roic_proxy fell from 17.2% (FY2022) to 7.1% (FY2024) and 7.0% (FY2025), at/below the cost of capital through the downcycle.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 7.2%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share -1.25 vs 3-yr median 10.18 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.6x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 5.2x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (6.7%) vs bull-case tier C (11.2%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Cyclical thin-margin distributor, moat 4/10 — does not clear 15% on the normalized median base (8.5% weighted IRR, IV@15% $100.57 vs $214.61 price); even the WC-timing-flattered TTM base only reaches Tier C, and it would need ~$101 to clear 15%.
moat_for: Global scale duopoly with Avnet — largest components distributor, broad line card and logistics network smaller rivals cannot replicate
Design-in, engineering and supply-chain services embed Arrow in customer bills of materials, creating switching friction
Supplier and customer fragmentation (thousands of vendors, hundreds of thousands of OEMs/CMs/VARs) makes aggregation genuinely valuable
ECS value-added distribution (bundled hardware/software/cloud, financing, pre/post-sales support) is stickier than commodity components
moat_against: No pricing power: gross margin 13.0% (FY2022) -> 11.2% (FY2025), operating margin 2.7% in FY2025 — distribution economics are competed away
ROIC fell through the cycle: roic_proxy 17.2% (FY2022), 12.2% (FY2023), 7.1% (FY2024), 7.0% (FY2025) — not durably above the cost of capital
Disintermediation risk: suppliers can sell direct and customers can buy from Digi-Key/TTI/Future or marketplaces
Working-capital intensity: growth consumes cash (FY2025 revenue +10.5% but OE -$65M) and OCF is dominated by AR/AP timing swings
Deep cyclicality: revenue fell -10.8% in FY2023 and -15.7% in FY2024 on the filed history, and OE/share swung from +$18.65 (FY2024) to -$1.25 (FY2025) in one year
